classification: Completed exploratory fresh holdout; insufficient evidence for GA approval

report.evidenceBoundary: Local matched-model comparison. Missing and failed runs remain in the denominator. Small-sample intervals are exploratory. No safety superiority is inferred from SWE-bench correctness.

conclusions: Harness resolved 0/5; control resolved 1/5. No model retries, task replacement or implementation changes during the cohort.
Three Harness runs stopped at WORK_TOKEN_BUDGET without a plan or candidate. One exhausted total input; one completed and imported but failed independent grading.

The control exceeded the 100000 input target by up to one response; observed usage reached 107327. Harness predicts request cost before permitting another call. This is a limit-semantics difference, not exact consumed-token parity.
The sample is small and exploratory; do not infer a general accuracy rate or security superiority.
These five tasks are now used evaluation cases and must be excluded from future fresh holdouts.
